Verified cite-by-cite against the pinned tree. Output written.

- `/home/mara/cwe-bench/pipelines/stacking/out/screener-ds-rescreen/8308.json`
- Trust decision: Express layer — `/mcp` dispatches all five LINE tools with no auth while the server binds `0.0.0.0` (`src/server.js:486`, `:558`); the fix adds a Bearer middleware at `/mcp` (fix.diff:216-231) plus loopback default and a non-loopback-without-token startup refusal (fix.diff:284-289).
- `pattern_fit`: **B** — a whole second HTTP server, `src/http-server.js:14/39/64`, exposes the same read/send sink unauthenticated on :3123 and was not touched by the fix.
- Strongest lever: `O3` reason-to-dismiss — that file is a Postman harness with no npm script, bin or manifest entry and is not "MCP mode", so models will argue it out of scope (real HOW-adjacent second implementation, but only one file away in a 5-file repo).
- Biggest red flag: `needs_gpu_kernel_gui` — package.json restricts `os` to win32/darwin, postinstall exits 1 on Linux, and `LineAutomation` throws at `src/automation/line-automation.js:16` in the server constructor, so the auth path cannot be exercised on a Linux runner without stubbing.
